description: The bundled page in the main window only (local content; no remote entry). There is deliberately no http permission or scope here: connect(address) grants exactly one origin at run time. The websocket plugin's connect permission is deliberately absent: the page opens sockets only through the shell's socket_* commands. The dialog and fs plugins get no permission either: native save (15c) is the shell's save_native command, which shows the dialog and writes in Rust.
